title: The Judgment of the Nations and the Feast of Tabernacles
description: The Lord sends a terrible plague upon the nations that have attacked Jerusalem: their flesh, eyes, and tongues rot while they stand on their feet, and great confusion from the Lord causes them to turn against one another. Even the animals in the camps are struck by this same plague. Judah fights at Jerusalem and gathers the wealth – gold, silver, and clothing – from the nations. Those who remain must go up year after year to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord of hosts, and celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles. Those who refuse, including Egypt, will be struck with drought and plague as punishment.
